headline: Your TreasurySpring waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing institutional cash buyers into the right TreasurySpring offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Henry Adams.
productSummary: TreasurySpring is the institutional cash investment platform: access to 1100+ investment-grade cash products across 120+ counterparties and 9 currencies through one point of access. Enterprise-grade technology for institutional cash management, with platform overview, integrations, security and compliance, API access, and an MCP server for connecting treasury data to AI. Buyer segments on-site: private markets (private funds, hedge funds, venture capital), financial institutions (asset managers, banks), corporations (large businesses and multinationals, SMEs and high-growth businesses), and not-for-profits (NGOs, charities, education). Founders: Henry Adams, Kevin Cook, Matthew Longhurst, and James Skillen.
coreInsight: Henry already sells a regulated cash investment platform to organisations sitting on large cash balances. Amelia's original pitch is the outbound problem: scrape the ICP, write to the right treasury and finance titles, and personalise on idle cash and platform access. The one list is in-TAM cash holders LinkedIn and company directories already surface. The one routing signal is the treasury job-keyword class in their open reqs, because Sales Nav returns that keyword in the same pull and it tells you whether they are staffing a Treasurer or Head of Cash, building out a liquidity analyst bench, running multi-currency treasury, or none of those yet. Segment labels (fund, bank, corporate, NFP) are merge tags and suppress filters after the account is routed. They are not a second waterfall.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is the treasury keyword already in the job post
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn already names the in-TAM organisation and already prints Treasurer, cash management, liquidity, or multi-currency language in the open req. That keyword is stronger than a cash-balance guess, and it is free to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every institutional cash buyer
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Treasurer and Head of Cash keywords go first, then liquidity and cash-management analyst keywords, then multi-currency or multi-entity treasury keywords, then every remaining in-TAM finance buyer.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each treasury keyword gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Treasurer hiring gets a Cash Access Brief. Liquidity analyst hiring gets a Desk Coverage Brief. Multi-currency treasury gets a Cross-Currency Cash Brief. The rest get the Institutional Cash Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Fill the treasury seat, cover the desk, unify the currencies, skip the spreadsheet
sections.takeaway: The list is always in-TAM cash holders, aimed at Treasurers, CFOs, Heads of Cash, and Finance Directors. Segment is a merge tag, not a second TAM. A/Bs sit on the exclusive routes.

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the req they already posted
sections.takeaway: Notice the keyword, poke the idle-cash or fragmented-access gap that keyword implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the Treasurer keyword first
sections.takeaway: Start where they are already staffing the cash seat, the problem the platform is built for. Prove reply density, then roll liquidity analyst hiring, multi-currency treasury, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: LinkedIn Sales Nav job search is the TAM Amelia already named, organisations with large cash balances and a visible treasury or finance title, and the cash or treasury keyword in one pull.

The same pull returns Treasurer / Head of Cash / Cash Manager, liquidity / money market / cash operations analyst, or multi-currency / multi-entity / FX treasury language, which is enough to route without a second enrichment product.
The ladder maps to live TreasurySpring positioning: one access point to 1100+ products, 120+ counterparties, and 9 currencies, plus platform integrations and API for the desk that is already hiring.
Fund, bank, corporate, and NFP labels are scrape filters and merge tags. They are not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last, never the TAM spine.

sources.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator job search
sources.delivers: In-TAM organisations plus the open-req keyword used to assign Tier 1 / 2 / 3 / catch-all. The TAM gate and the spine of every route. One pull.

sources.name: Company careers / jobs page scrape
sources.delivers: Posted role text when Sales Nav truncates the keyword, plus segment as a merge tag when the about page names fund, bank, corporate, or NFP

sources.name: LinkedIn company + title graph
sources.delivers: Treasurer, Head of Cash, CFO, Finance Director, Cash Manager, Liquidity Analyst after the domain is routed. Title is a merge tag, not a second TAM.

sources.name: Optional Companies House / public filings / Crunchbase
sources.delivers: Backup in_tam when cash-on-hand or recent funding is visible. Gate only. Do not invent a cash cutoff that is not on treasuryspring.com.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw 'CFO at funds' list and hope.

sources.name: Optional TreasurySpring customer suppress
sources.delivers: Current-customer exclusion when the signal is visible. Thin coverage. Treat as a suppress list, not a tier.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND job_keyword_class = treasurer_or_head_of_cash (Treasurer, Head of Treasury, Head of Cash, Cash Manager, Corporate Treasurer)
routingRules.why: They are staffing the cash seat now. Strongest intent for a one-access institutional cash platform.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND job_keyword_class = liquidity_or_cash_ops (Liquidity Analyst, Cash Operations, Money Market Analyst, Treasury Analyst)
routingRules.why: They are expanding the desk that already manages cash product access. Pain is coverage and product breadth, not starting from zero.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND job_keyword_class = multi_currency_or_entity (multi-currency treasury, FX cash, multi-entity cash, international treasury)
routingRules.why: Their open req already names currency or entity complexity. Maps to the 9-currency one-access pitch on treasuryspring.com.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (funds, banks, corporates, NFPs with meaningful cash). Softest CTA, broadest copy, mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Treasurer / Head of Cash hiring
tiers.trigger: Open req for Treasurer, Head of Treasury, Head of Cash, or Cash Manager
tiers.pain: They are hiring the person who owns idle cash and product access, which usually means the current stack is fragmented or still sitting in bank deposits.
tiers.valueProp: One regulated access point to 1100+ investment-grade cash products across 120+ counterparties.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Sales Nav job search + careers page
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they are staffing the exact seat the platform serves

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Liquidity / cash ops hiring
tiers.trigger: Open req for Liquidity Analyst, Treasury Analyst, Cash Operations, or Money Market Analyst
tiers.pain: They are adding capacity on a desk that already moves cash, so product breadth and counterparty coverage become the bottleneck.
tiers.valueProp: Desk-ready access across counterparties without rebuilding banking relationships one by one.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Sales Nav job search + careers page
tiers.replyDensity: High - hiring proves an active cash desk

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Multi-currency / multi-entity treasury
tiers.trigger: Open req or title language naming multi-currency, FX cash, multi-entity, or international treasury
tiers.pain: Cash is split across currencies and entities, so yield and access decisions get stuck in spreadsheets and local bank portals.
tiers.valueProp: Nine currencies through one institutional access point.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Sales Nav job search + careers / about page
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - complexity is visible, urgency varies

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM cash holders
tiers.trigger: In-TAM fund, bank, corporate, or NFP with a finance decision maker and no Tier 1-3 keyword
tiers.pain: Meaningful cash is still parked without a clear institutional product access path.
tiers.valueProp: A simple path to investment-grade cash products without rebuilding the treasury stack.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn company + title graph after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. 10,000+ (flagged estimate; catch-all must cover remaining TAM)

campaigns.name: Cash seat just opened
campaigns.strategy: Lead with the open Treasurer / Head of Cash req, then offer a one-page Cash Access Brief showing how peers get 1100+ products through one platform.
campaigns.value: Fill the seat with product access already solved

campaigns.name: Desk is hiring coverage
campaigns.strategy: Name the analyst / ops req, poke counterparty and product-breadth drag, offer the Desk Coverage Brief.
campaigns.value: Cover more cash without more bank portals
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. Keep copy desk-specific, not CFO-generic.

campaigns.name: Currencies and entities are the pain
campaigns.strategy: Lead with the multi-currency or multi-entity language in the req, then the 9-currency one-access pitch.
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. {{currency_count}} is a merge tag when visible.

campaigns.name: Remaining institutional cash
campaigns.strategy: Soft Institutional Cash Playbook. Segment and title as merge tags. Soft CTA.
campaigns.value: Simple path to institutional cash products

launchPlan: Confirm in_tam definition from TreasurySpring segments: private markets, financial institutions, corporations, not-for-profits with meaningful cash.
Pull Sales Nav job search for treasurer_or_head_of_cash keywords and suppress known customers.
Launch Tier 1 only until reply density is clear (target ~1 positive / 150-300).
Add Tier 2 liquidity/cash-ops hiring once Tier 1 copy is stable.
Add Tier 3 multi-currency / multi-entity, then the catch-all for remaining in-TAM finance buyers.
Enrich emails via Apollo only after the account is routed.
A/B soft CTA vs Cash Access Brief offer on Tier 1 before cloning to lower tiers.

thresholds.action: Scale the tier and clone winning angles downward
Test a subject or offer variant before cutting
Cut the tier and move volume to the next exclusive route
